# contextforge_agent (Resource)

Manages a ContextForge A2A (Agent-to-Agent) agent resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_url` (String) Agent endpoint URL
- `name` (String) Agent name

### Optional

- `agent_type` (String) Agent type
- `auth_query_param_key` (String) Authentication query parameter key
- `auth_query_param_value` (String, Sensitive) Authentication query parameter value
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type
- `config` (Dynamic) Agent configuration (arbitrary JSON object)
- `description` (String) Agent description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the agent is enabled (defaults to true)
- `oauth_config` (Dynamic, Sensitive) OAuth configuration
- `protocol_version` (String) A2A protocol version
- `tags` (List of String) Agent tags
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)

### Read-Only

- `auth_query_param_value_masked` (String) Masked authentication query parameter value
- `capabilities` (Dynamic) Agent capabilities (computed from agent metadata)
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `created_by` (String) User who created the agent (read-only metadata)
- `created_from_ip` (String) IP address of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_user_agent` (String) User agent of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_via` (String) Creation method (read-only metadata)
- `federation_source` (String) Federation source (read-only metadata)
- `id` (String) Agent ID
- `import_batch_id` (String) Import batch identifier (read-only metadata)
- `last_interaction` (String) Last interaction timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `metrics` (Attributes) Agent performance metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `modified_by` (String) User who last modified the agent (read-only metadata)
- `modified_from_ip` (String) IP address of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_user_agent` (String) User agent of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_via` (String) Modification method (read-only metadata)
- `owner_email` (String) Owner email address
- `reachable` (Boolean) Whether the agent is reachable
- `slug` (String) Agent slug (URL-friendly identifier)
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `version` (Number) Version number (read-only metadata)
